questions.question: Since ⌘? can't reach a TUI in Terminal.app or iTerm2, how should Mac users get help from terminal focus?

options.label: Alt-h as a global fallback (Recommended)
options.description: Add Alt-h alongside F1, global in both modes — same shape as the existing Alt-o for the file manager. Alt-letter isn't a standard readline or agent binding, so the PTY loses nothing, and it works identically on all three OSes rather than being a Mac-only patch.

options.label: Also accept Cmd+? where it works
options.description: Add SUPER+'?' as an extra macOS binding, mirroring how is_paste_shortcut already handles Cmd-V. Native where the terminal forwards Cmd (Kitty, Alacritty, WezTerm); silently absent in Terminal.app and iTerm2 — so it helps the minority and leaves the majority stuck.

options.label: Accept it, document it
options.description: F1 stays the only terminal-focus route. Note the Fn+F1 / "standard function keys" requirement in the README. Mac users on external keyboards are unaffected; laptop users press Esc then '?' as they do today.
